# FILE: Chart.yaml
apiVersion: v2
name: flask-microservice
description: Production Helm chart for Python Flask microservice
type: application
version: 1.0.0
appVersion: "1.0.0"
---
# FILE: values.yaml
replicaCount: 3
image:
  repository: flask-microservice
  tag: latest
  pullPolicy: IfNotPresent
service:
  type: ClusterIP
  port: 8080
ingress:
  enabled: true
  className: nginx
  host: app.example.com
  tls:
    enabled: true
    secretName: flask-microservice-tls
resources:
  requests:
    cpu: 100m
    memory: 128Mi
  limits:
    cpu: 500m
    memory: 512Mi
autoscaling:
  enabled: true
  minReplicas: 3
  maxReplicas: 20
  targetCPUUtilizationPercentage: 70
serviceMonitor:
  enabled: true
  interval: 30s
  path: /metrics
securityContext:
  runAsNonRoot: true
  runAsUser: 1000
  allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
---
# FILE: templates/deployment.yaml
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: {{ include "flask-microservice.fullname" . }}
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: {{ include "flask-microservice.name" . }}
    app.kubernetes.io/instance: {{ .Release.Name }}
spec:
  replicas: {{ .Values.replicaCount }}
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/name: {{ include "flask-microservice.name" . }}
      app.kubernetes.io/instance: {{ .Release.Name }}
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app.kubernetes.io/name: {{ include "flask-microservice.name" . }}
        app.kubernetes.io/instance: {{ .Release.Name }}
    spec:
      securityContext:
        {{- toYaml .Values.securityContext | nindent 8 }}
      containers:
        - name: flask
          image: "{{ .Values.image.repository }}:{{ .Values.image.tag }}"
          imagePullPolicy: {{ .Values.image.pullPolicy }}
          ports:
            - containerPort: 8080
          resources:
            {{- toYaml .Values.resources | nindent 12 }}
---
# FILE: templates/service.yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: {{ include "flask-microservice.fullname" . }}
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: {{ include "flask-microservice.name" . }}
    app.kubernetes.io/instance: {{ .Release.Name }}
spec:
  type: {{ .Values.service.type }}
  ports:
    - port: {{ .Values.service.port }}
      targetPort: 8080
      protocol: TCP
  selector:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: {{ include "flask-microservice.name" . }}
    app.kubernetes.io/instance: {{ .Release.Name }}
---
# FILE: templates/ingress.yaml
{{- if .Values.ingress.enabled }}
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: Ingress
metadata:
  name: {{ include "flask-microservice.fullname" . }}
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: {{ include "flask-microservice.name" . }}
    app.kubernetes.io/instance: {{ .Release.Name }}
spec:
  ingressClassName: {{ .Values.ingress.className }}
  tls:
    {{- if .Values.ingress.tls.enabled }}
    - hosts:
        - {{ .Values.ingress.host }}
      secretName: {{ .Values.ingress.tls.secretName }}
    {{- end }}
  rules:
    - host: {{ .Values.ingress.host }}
      http:
        paths:
          - path: /
            pathType: Prefix
            backend:
              service:
                name: {{ include "flask-microservice.fullname" . }}
                port:
                  number: {{ .Values.service.port }}
{{- end }}
---
# FILE: templates/hpa.yaml
{{- if .Values.autoscaling.enabled }}
apiVersion: autoscaling/v2
kind: HorizontalPodAutoscaler
metadata:
  name: {{ include "flask-microservice.fullname" . }}
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: {{ include "flask-microservice.name" . }}
    app.kubernetes.io/instance: {{ .Release.Name }}
spec:
  scaleTargetRef:
    apiVersion: apps/v1
    kind: Deployment
    name: {{ include "flask-microservice.fullname" . }}
  minReplicas: {{ .Values.autoscaling.minReplicas }}
  maxReplicas: {{ .Values.autoscaling.maxReplicas }}
  metrics:
    - type: Resource
      resource:
        name: cpu
        target:
          type: Utilization
          averageUtilization: {{ .Values.autoscaling.targetCPUUtilizationPercentage }}
{{- end }}
---
# FILE: templates/servicemonitor.yaml
{{- if .Values.serviceMonitor.enabled }}
apiVersion: monitoring.coreos.com/v1
kind: ServiceMonitor
metadata:
  name: {{ include "flask-microservice.fullname" . }}
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: {{ include "flask-microservice.name" . }}
    app.kubernetes.io/instance: {{ .Release.Name }}
spec:
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/name: {{ include "flask-microservice.name" . }}
      app.kubernetes.io/instance: {{ .Release.Name }}
  endpoints:
    - port: {{ .Values.service.port }}
      path: {{ .Values.serviceMonitor.path }}
      interval: {{ .Values.serviceMonitor.interval }}
{{- end }}
